keywords: how to find buyers in france
export to france from india b2b
intro: Two outbound campaigns for Indian manufacturers selling into France: a tablet and capsule maker reaching pharma sourcing teams, and a carton maker reaching cosmetics brands. Every number below comes from a real campaign.

audiences.title: Indian manufacturers exporting to France
audiences.body: Pharma contract manufacturers, packaging makers and other exporters whose French relationships start and stop at trade shows.

audiences.title: Suppliers to French brands
audiences.body: Companies selling to French pharma, cosmetics and consumer brands that need to reach sourcing, procurement and development teams directly.

plays.title: Write in French and English
plays.body: A tablet and capsule maker reached sourcing, external manufacturing and supply chain leads at French pharma companies whose portfolios matched its dosage forms. Messages went out in French and English.

plays.title: Go to the packaging development team
plays.body: A carton and printed packaging maker mapped French cosmetics brands that fit its capabilities, then contacted packaging development, procurement and operations leaders about upcoming packaging needs.

rulesBody: France applies GDPR, and its regulator, the CNIL, accepts B2B email prospecting without prior consent when the message relates to the recipient's job, the recipient is told how their data is used and they can opt out easily. We keep messages role-relevant and honour every opt-out.
timingBody: France is 3.5 hours behind India in summer and 4.5 hours in winter. Messages go out on French weekday mornings. The pharma campaign wrote to sourcing teams in both French and English.
